name: Claude-BugHunter
description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
one_liner: A plug-in pack that turns an AI coding assistant into a trained bug-bounty hunter, complete with attack playbooks and report templates.
buyer: A freelance penetration tester or bug-bounty hunter who bills by the engagement and wants to find more valid vulnerabilities per hour.
business_use_cases: A solo pentester uses it to run first-pass recon and vulnerability triage on a new client engagement overnight.
A boutique security consultancy standardizes report quality across junior testers using its 7-Question validation gate.
A bug-bounty hunter runs it against in-scope HackerOne targets to speed up chain discovery on enterprise identity systems.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed 'AI-assisted bug bounty hunting' retainer service built on top of this toolkit.
Sell a packaged, hardened fork with extra proprietary exploit chains to security consultancies.

steal_this: Package this as an opinionated 'day-one pentest kit' for freelancers, add a report-formatting wrapper, and sell setup + onboarding as a weekend consulting gig.
